ActionResult.description: The signal that was sent, and who it was sent as.
ActionResult.title: ActionResult

MemoryItemView.description: A row of `memory_items` without its vector.
MemoryItemView.title: MemoryItemView

PlanView.description: One version of the plan of a task, with the decision on it.
PlanView.title: PlanView

StopDetails.description: Why the model stopped, when the provider says. Today only a refusal carries details.
StopDetails.title: StopDetails

TaskDetail.description:
A task as the console's detail page shows it.

The row is what the activities last wrote, and it can lag behind the task. `live` is the
answer of the workflow to its status query, so it is current, and it is None when nobody can
answer: the workflow is gone, Temporal is down, or no worker is running. `workflow` says
which of these it was.
TaskDetail.title: TaskDetail

TaskRecord.description: The whole row, with the settings the task runs with and its context totals.
TaskRecord.title: TaskRecord

TaskSummary.description: One row of the task list: what the `tasks` table says.
TaskSummary.title: TaskSummary

TimelineToolCall.description: One tool call. `ts` is when its row was written, which is when the call ended.
TimelineToolCall.title: TimelineToolCall

TimelineTurn.description: One model call. A turn that was asked again has a row for each attempt.
TimelineTurn.title: TimelineTurn

ToolOutput.description:
Lines `start_line` to `end_line` of the full output of a tool call, redacted.

Line numbers count the redacted text. `next_start` is set when the page ended before the
range that was asked for did.
ToolOutput.title: ToolOutput

TurnDetail.description:
The request and the reply of one model call, as stored and then redacted.

`request` is the transcript the call began from. `response` is None for a call that failed
after it was billed. `attempts` lists every attempt of the turn, and `attempt` is the one
shown: the last, unless the caller asked for another.
TurnDetail.title: TurnDetail

info.description: Tasks, timelines, actions and memory for the Longhaul console. The console reads this API and nothing else: it never talks to the database or to Temporal.
info.title: Longhaul console API

get.description: Memory items, oldest first. With no `repo`, the items of every repo.

post.description: Approve an item, so that it can reach the prompt of later tasks.
Reject an item. It stays in the table and never reaches a prompt.

get.description: The repos Longhaul knows, from `repo_settings`, with how many tasks each has.
Tasks, newest first. `status` and `repo` narrow the list.
The row of a task, the answer of its workflow if there is one, and its plan.

post.description: Approve the plan the task is waiting on.
Add dollars, turns or both to the budget of the task.
Stop the task. It cleans up and ends with the cancelled outcome.
Give the agent a hint. A paused task resumes with it.
Reject the plan with feedback. The planner writes a new version.

get.description: Events, model calls and tool calls of a task, merged by time, oldest first.
Lines `start` to `end` (1-based, inclusive) of the full output of a tool call.

What was sent to the model on one turn and what came back, with secrets redacted.

A turn that was asked again has several attempts. The last is shown unless `attempt` names
another.
Prometheus text: the worker metrics of this process and the API's own.
